title: GS1 Domain Codelist
description: The GS1 Domain code list, published as its own resource because it changes seldom and may be reused by other GS1 tooling. Publish at registry/domains.jsonld. The SPA fetches this at runtime as the source of truth for domains navigation; adding, renaming or reordering a donain requires no SPA code change or redeploy, only an update here.

codeValue.description: max 10-letter domain code, e.g. rail, bearing.

codeName.description: Human-readable domain label, e.g. 'Domain Rail – Railway'.
